title: Universal Nuts
native_title: ユニバーサル・ナッツ
overview:
A lit cigarette, a half-finished bowl of soup, a chessboard mid-game. The ferry we reached was wrapped in a calm atmosphere. ...Except for one thing: there was not a single crew member or passenger aboard.

Universal Nuts is a science fiction adventure set in an age of faster-than-light space travel. Cousins Yui and Ai Asuka are using their summer vacation to travel from Earth when a warp accident throws their ship into a meteor cluster. Adrift and damaged, the survivors must board a mysterious ghost ship to stay alive. Make your choices carefully as the story branches, because a wrong decision can mean instant death.

- Holder system lets you look up important terms from the story
- Recollection mode lets you page back through earlier text
- Voiced characters
- Memory backup

火の点いた煙草、
飲みかけのスープ、
対戦途中のチェスボード。
たどりついたフェリーの船内は
穏やかな空気に包まれていた。
…ただひとつ、
乗員乗客が一人もいないことを除けば。
